+import re, html.parser
+
+report = "report-preview.html"
+src = open(report, encoding="utf-8").read()
+
+print("=== 1. EXTERNAL RESOURCE SCAN (must be zero for offline guarantee) ===")
+forbidden = {
+    "<script": r"<script",
+    "<link":   r"<link\b",
+    "<img":    r"<img\b",
+    "<iframe": r"<iframe\b",
+    "@import": r"@import\b",
+    "url()":   r"url\s*\(",
+    "fetch/XHR/WS": r"\b(fetch\(|XMLHttpRequest|WebSocket|import\()",
+}
+clean = True
+for name, pat in forbidden.items():
+    hits = re.findall(pat, src, re.I)
+    print(f"  {name:24s} -> {len(hits)} found")
+    clean &= not hits
+
+urls = re.findall(r'https?://[^\s"<]+', src)
+res_urls = [u for u in urls if re.search(r'\.(css|js|png|jpe?g|svg|woff2?|ico)($|\?)', u, re.I)]
+print(f"  external URLs total: {len(urls)}  (all plain hyperlinks, none load resources: {len(res_urls)==0})")
+for u in urls:
+    print(f"    - {u}")
+
+print("\n=== 2. ANCHOR NAVIGATION (TOC -> section ids) ===")
+hrefs = set(re.findall(r'href="#([^"]+)"', src))
+ids = re.findall(r'\bid="([^"]+)"', src)
+dupes = sorted({i for i in ids if ids.count(i) > 1})
+missing = sorted(hrefs - set(ids))
+print(f"  internal anchors: {len(hrefs)}, ids: {len(set(ids))}, duplicate ids: {dupes if dupes else 'NONE'}")
+print(f"  unresolved anchors: {missing if missing else 'NONE - every TOC link resolves'}")
+
+print("\n=== 3. <meter> RANGE VALIDATION (browser computes gauge width from value/min/max) ===")
+ok = True
+for m in re.finditer(r'<meter([^>]*)>', src):
+    a = dict(re.findall(r'([\w-]+)="([^"]*)"', m.group(1)))
+    mn, mx, v = float(a.get('min', 0)), float(a.get('max', 1)), float(a.get('value', 0))
+    inrange = mn <= v <= mx
+    ok &= inrange
+    print(f"  value={v:5.1f} min={mn:.0f} max={mx:.0f} -> {'OK' if inrange else 'OUT OF RANGE'}")
+print(f"  all meters within range: {ok}")
+
+print("\n=== 4. RAG BADGE CONTRACT (markup <-> CSS <-> machine value) ===")
+used = {c.removeprefix("rag ")
+        for c in re.findall(r'class="(rag(?: rag-\w+)?)"', src)}
+css = set(re.findall(r'\.(rag-\w+)\s*\{', src))
+print(f"  used in markup (normalized): {sorted(used)}")
+print(f"  defined in CSS: {sorted(css)}")
+print(f"  used-but-undefined: {sorted(used - css) if used - css else 'NONE'}")
+pairs = re.findall(r'<data class="rag rag-\w+" value="([^"]*)">([A-Z][A-Z ]*)</data>', src)
+bad = [(v, l) for v, l in pairs
+       if v != l.strip().lower().replace(" ", "-")]
+print(f"  <data value> vs visible label mismatches: {bad if bad else 'NONE'}")
+
+print("\n=== 5. TAG BALANCE (well-formedness) ===")
+class Chk(html.parser.HTMLParser):
+    VOID = {"meta", "br", "hr", "img", "input", "link"}
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__(); self.stack = []; self.errs = []
+    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
+        if tag not in self.VOID:
+            self.stack.append(tag)
+    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
+        if tag in self.VOID:
+            return
+        if self.stack and self.stack[-1] == tag:
+            self.stack.pop()
+        else:
+            top = self.stack[-1] if self.stack else "empty"
+            self.errs.append(f"mismatched </{tag}> (stack top: {top})")
+c = Chk(); c.feed(src)
+print(f"  unclosed tags: {c.stack if c.stack else 'NONE'}")
+print(f"  mismatches: {c.errs if c.errs else 'NONE'}")
+
+print("\n=== 6. CSS FEATURE FLOOR ===")
+for feat in ["color-mix", "columns:", "repeat(auto-fit", "@media print", ":focus-visible"]:
+    print(f"  '{feat}' present: {feat in src}")
+
+print("\n=== 7. TEMPLATE GETS THE SAME PASS ===")
+tpl = open("report-template.html", encoding="utf-8").read()
+t_hits = {n: len(re.findall(p, tpl, re.I)) for n, p in forbidden.items()}
+print(f"  template external-resource hits: {t_hits} (all zero: {not any(t_hits.values())})")

+++ /home/agent/workspace/fix_badges.py
@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+import re
+
+path = "report-preview.html"
+src = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
+
+def fix(m):
+    cls, label = m.group(1), m.group(2)
+    machine = label.strip().lower().replace(" ", "-")
+    return f'<data class="rag rag-{cls}" value="{machine}">{label}</data>'
+
+new, n = re.subn(
+    r'<data class="rag rag-(\w+)" value="\w*">([A-Z][A-Z ]*)</data>',
+    fix, src)
+open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(new)
+print(f"badges rewritten: {n}")
+for m in re.finditer(r'<data class="rag rag-\w+" value="[^"]+">[^<]+</data>', new):
+    print(f"  {m.group(0)}")
